heading: Sunset
lead: This program shall expire on the date that is 7 years after the date of enactment of this chapter.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The date of enactment of this chapter, referred to in text, is the date of enactment of Pub. L. 115–104, which was approved Jan. 8, 2018.
